COOL-DOWN:
- 9min easy spin Z1-Z2 (RPE 3-4)

sessions.description:
FUEL:
Normal meal ~2h before. One bottle, 40-50g carbs. Done.

WARM-UP:
-12min ramp Z1->Z2, then 2x1min @113% with 1min easy

MAIN SET:
-3 sets of 11x (30s @110% FTP / 15s @50%)
-3min @50% between sets
-Cadence: 90-110rpm, seated and smooth

EXECUTION:
-Hit target on every 30s. The float is a true easy spin. End a set if you can't hold the 30s power in its back third.

NUTRITION:
-30-60g carbs/hr.

HYDRATION:
-500-750ml/hr with electrolytes.

RPE guide: 113% FTP -> RPE 8-9; 110% FTP -> RPE 8-9; 50% FTP -> RPE 3
sessions.pre_activity_comment:
Feels great? Extend the duration at the same power -- never add power.
Failed a set? Resume after 5-10min easy only if the early reps weren't already a struggle. Struggling from rep one: spin home easy and tell me.
sessions.target_summary: 50-70 % of measured FTP; 113 / 50 % of measured FTP; 110 / 50 % of measured FTP; 50 % of measured FTP; 70-50 % of measured FTP

Feeling flat today is normal. Still flat on Friday, message me.

Reset day. The block lands now.

A walk, a stretch, food on the plate. Nothing with a heart-rate strap.

If you are itching to ride, good. Hold it. That itch is the fitness arriving.
sessions.title: Rest Day

sessions.description:
FUEL:
Normal meal ~2h before. One bottle, 40-50g carbs. Done.

MAIN SET:
- 24min @ 65% FTP (Z2, RPE 3)
- 2 x (0:18 @ 140% FTP (Z5+, RPE 8-9) + 2:30 @ 55% FTP (Z2, RPE 3))
- 0:18 @ 140% FTP (Z5+, RPE 8-9)
- 5min @ 50% FTP (Z1, RPE 3)
-Cadence: 95-105rpm on efforts
-Position: Seated, relaxed

PROGRESSION:
-Level 1/6: Introductory - Focus on form and learning the workout pattern
-Short alactic openers -- three brief near-max efforts to wake up neuromuscular firing without creating fatigue

EXECUTION:
-Short sharp efforts to keep the legs remembering speed. Don't dig deep - this should feel like play, not training.
sessions.target_summary: 65 % of measured FTP; 140 % of measured FTP; 55 % of measured FTP; 50 % of measured FTP
